recipes.name: Key Lime Pie VIII
ingredients_raw: 1 (10 inch) pie crust, baked and cooled
1 (3.5 ounce) package instant vanilla pudding mix
1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps.text: In a large bowl, mix together lime rind, lime juice, and condensed milk. Whisk in pudding mix and allow to set up 5 minutes. Fold in 8 ounce tub of whipped topping. Pour mixture into pastry shell. Chill at least 2 hours before serving. Garnish with additional whipped topping if desired.

raw_recipe.headline: Key Lime Pie VIII
raw_recipe.description: Fresh lime juice, oodles of grated lime rind, vanilla pudding, and whipped topping make the difference in this version of key lime pie made with sweetened condensed milk. After two hours in the fridge, it 's ready to wow your guests. Decorate with thinly cut slices of lime and whipped topping.

review.reviewBody: This recipe was wonderful with a slight modification. Instead of using a tub of cool whip I mixed my own cream and didn't add any sugar to sweeten it. It cut down on the sweetness of the pie (and the recongnizable sweetened condensed milk flavor) and enhanced the tartness. This will now be the only recipe I use to make this pie.

As mentioned by an earlier reviewer - using the thawed can of frozen margarita mix in place of the lime juice makes this an incredible dessert. I also recommend making (and baking 8 min) your own graham cracker crust. And ditch the Cool Whip ....use fresh whipped whipping cream instead and you won't regret it. Note: only add 1 tsp powdered sugar to the whipping cream. This adaptation is VERY rich, but has just the right tartness and not overwhelmingly sweet.

I made little "dessert shooters" in disposable shot glasses. I topped each with a squirt of canned whipping cream and a sprinkling of crushed crumbs (instead of crust). Huge hit! Just the right amount of tangy sweetness. Loved 'em!

Another good key lime pie recipe. I didn't have a pie crust on hand, nor did I have a graham cracker crust, put I did have a box of 'Nilla Wafers ®. I wanted these for a "Girls Night Out" dinner, so I decided to make mini bite-sized pies. I put one wafer in a mini cupcake cake paper, mixed the filling ingredients as directed, and used my small cookie scoop to fill the cupcake papers. These set up nicely in the refrigerator and held their shape for 1 1/2 hours out of the fridge. Yes, they got soft, but they didn't "melt down". This was a fun way to serve this pie to a group of women. Everyone had a few of them and there were some for the ladies to take home. I got 42 minis out of this recipe.

Best key lime pie!! I love it because it has lots of lime flavour, and doesn't just taste like sweetened condensed milk. Instead of key limes, I just used 5-6 regular limes (less labour intensive). I used a bit extra zest for more lime flavour. I also substitued 8oz of real whipping cream instead of the whipped topping. (whipped it up with a couple tsp of sugar).

This was fabulous, so easy! They don't have key lime juice where i live so i had to squeeze the limes with a garlic press) I did however made my own crust and put a thin layer of melted chocolate on it, I also used reduced sugar pudding and topping. I gave this 5 stars because if it tasted absolutely delish with reduced sugar products I'm sure the real products were just as good!

I added 1-8oz package of low fat cream cheese, to the rest of the ingredients. I put everything into the food processor to help make it very creamy and folded in 1/2 of the container of cool whip, the rest I used on top. My husband & I loved it, the perfect blend of sour and sweet.

My family does not like key lime pie, but they absolutely love this recipe. Instead of vanilla pudding, I subbed white chocolate pudding...will always use the white chocolate pudding every time I make it again! I used homemade sweetened condensed milk (equal parts of sugar and evaporated milk + a splash of vanilla) and fresh limes...I froze it for about 3 hours and served it with real whipped cream that was whipped with a splash of vanilla and a couple of handfuls of 10X sugar. Excellent, excellent pie!

Absolutely delicious! My husband couldn't stop raving! I used a homemade graham crust, and freshly whipped cream in place of the Cool Whip (1 1/4 cups unwhipped). Per reviews that it was too tangy, I cut the lime juice to 3/4 cup. This was a beautiful color with the lime zest throughout. Wonderful! UPDATE: I served this on the dessert table on Christmas Day, garnishing each slice with a rosette of whipped cream and a small piece of fresh lime - it was the first thing gone! Everyone loved it and it is so refreshing in the middle of winter.

I made two batches of this recipe side by side. But, I left out (inadvertantly) the pudding mix in one of the batches....and that batch was SO much better! I also tried this crumbling a graham cracker crust into individual size footed glass bowls. They were adorable and delicious (without the pudding!) Lastly,I found a *huge* difference in using fresh limes vs. bottled key lime juice. The bottled juice left a stong imitation lime after taste. I'll only use fresh lime juice now.

This is a wonderful pie! I used prebaked graham cracker crust. Instead of fresh lime juice, I used 1/4 cup bottled lemon juice and 3/4 cup frozen limeade. I used lots of lime zest from one lime...and the licking began! Thanks for the recipe!
So good! I made it with cheesecake pudding mix instead of vanilla. Also, increased the graham cracker crust to almost double. Delicious, I will make this again!

My family loves this! It’s fluffier than what one might be used to, but I love anything with cool whip ;) we like to use a graham cracker crust to offset the fluff. Also don’t use but 1/2-3/4 cup lime juice.

Couldn't have been easier. And delicious! We didn't have quite enough limes so used only about 2/3 cup of juice and that was plenty. We also bought a pre-made pecan crumb crust which was great! Absolutely will make again.
Easy & delicious. I made my own whipped cream.
Light tangy and refreshing! Easy summer treat!
Absolutely delicious! The only difference I made was I used only 3/4 a container of whipped topping instead of the whole container. Definitely making this again.
Pretty good recipe and very simple and cheap to make
my kids and I loved this! made exactly as recipe stated!
Really good! i only had cheesecake flavored instant pudding and it tasted great. this was super refreshing and so tasty. definitely a make again!
